items.title: A meteor hit Oklahoma 100 million years later than scientists thought

items.title: Diet drinks work as well as water for weight loss, major trial finds
items.summary: A two-year randomized clinical trial involving 493 adults with overweight or obesity found that diet soft drinks were essentially as effective as water for long-term weight loss and weight maintenance.
